benchmarks.title: Completion Cap & Truncation Budget
benchmarks.results_summary: 24/30 valid (cap 256) vs 30/30 valid (cap 512). Paired exact McNemar p = .03125.
benchmarks.details: All 6 failures at cap 256 terminated with finish_reason='length', and subsequently completed validly at 261–321 tokens when given 512 budget.
benchmarks.limitations: One deterministic 30-item fixed suite/model/config; demonstrates truncation failure mechanism, not universal cap behavior.

benchmarks.title: Grammar Constraint: JSON Schema vs JSON Object
benchmarks.results_summary: Schema 30/30 in each run; json_object 18/30 in each run. 12/0 discordance, exact McNemar p = .000488.
benchmarks.details: Under ~7k context, strict JSON Schema grammars eliminated malformed key-value syntax and truncation errors observed with unconstrained json_object mode.
benchmarks.limitations: Syntactic schema compliance does not guarantee semantic correctness. Evaluated on one fixed prompt/model family.

benchmarks.title: Native vs JSON-Mediated Tool Calling
benchmarks.results_summary: Native tool calling 18/18; JSON-mediated variants 2–8/18 across 1.9k, 3.8k, and 7k contexts.
benchmarks.details: Native llama.cpp tool-call parsing demonstrated robustness to context expansion; prompt-engineered JSON tool dispatch suffered token degradation.
benchmarks.limitations: Prompts, schemas, and parsers differ between arms; fixed synthetic test cases.

benchmarks.title: KV Precision Scaling & Needle Retrieval
benchmarks.results_summary: Needle panel 30/30 on both f16 and q8_0 KV; peak VRAM dropped 2,118.1 → 1,702.1 MiB (-416 MiB, -19.6%).
benchmarks.details: H1 KV scaling demonstrated memory slope of ≈113.0 KiB/token (f16) vs 60.3 KiB/token (q8_0), with fixed model base of ~1206 MiB. Paired quality (n=20) showed ARC .35→.40 and HellaSwag .40→.40 (p=1.0).
benchmarks.limitations: Needle retrieval ceiling at 30/30 cannot bound subtle semantic quality loss; n=20 quality evaluation is underpowered.

benchmarks.title: Llama-3.2-3B Partial GPU Layer Offloading
benchmarks.results_summary: 99 layers (all GPU): 2364 MiB, 30.4s. 24 layers: 2074 MiB (-290 MiB) at ~26% lower decode. 16 layers: 1612 MiB (-752 MiB) at ~48% lower decode.
benchmarks.details: Demonstrates the step-function trade-off when splitting layers across PCIe 3.0 between GPU VRAM and CPU system RAM.
benchmarks.limitations: Model-specific layer boundary; dependent on host DDR4 bus speed and CPU cache behavior.

benchmarks.title: Concurrency Slot Scaling (1 vs 2 vs 4 slots)
benchmarks.results_summary: 1→4 slots increased aggregate throughput by +20.4% across 3 repeated leases, with duration dropping from 35.1s to 21.3s.
benchmarks.details: Peak VRAM held constant at 1530.1 MiB with cache-ram 0. Equal-context per-slot grid remains partially executed.
benchmarks.limitations: Per-slot context was reduced (8192→2048) between configurations, so not fully context-equivalent; n=3 leases per arm is exploratory.

benchmarks.title: HotpotQA Support-Order RAG Pilot
benchmarks.results_summary: 15 paired items completed (3 of 20 batches). Support-first: 8/15 EM; Support-last: 7/15 EM.
benchmarks.details: Tested closed-context multi-hop QA with 10 candidate passages. Paired condition moved support passages from first to last with exact token parity.
benchmarks.limitations: Pilot halted at batch 3/20 during operational verification check; descriptive pilot only, not a representative population estimate.

benchmarks.title: Static CWE Vulnerability Triage v2
benchmarks.results_summary: Benchmark specification ready: 24 test cases with hand-authored CWE classification labels. Evaluator tested and passing.
benchmarks.details: Evaluates defensive vulnerability triaging without executing exploit code. Verifies whether models accurately identify CWE weakness classes.
benchmarks.limitations: Ready benchmark: NO model has yet been run against this suite. Historical exploratory probes showed 50-100% prompt injection susceptibility.

benchmarks.title: CVE Advisory Triage v1 (NVD Verified)
benchmarks.results_summary: Benchmark specification ready: 20 test cases verified against NVD 2.0 and MITRE upstream advisories with per-case provenance.
benchmarks.details: Tests whether models correctly summarize CVSS severity vectors, affected version bounds, and remediation patches.
benchmarks.limitations: Ready benchmark: NO model execution yet. Labels are locked and verified, awaiting authorized model evaluation.

benchmarks.title: AppSec Chatbot Boundary Enforcement Scenarios
benchmarks.results_summary: Benchmark specification ready: 18 scenarios testing tool authorization, parameter boundary enforcement, and interceptor blocks.
benchmarks.details: Simulates conversational assistant interactions with access to diagnostic tools, verifying prompt injection resistance and boundary defense.
benchmarks.limitations: Ready benchmark: NO model run has been recorded. Transcripts are scripted author test fixtures.

research_questions.title: Context × Memory Frontier
research_questions.question: For each quantized SLM, what maximum context (with ≥256 MiB headroom) fits 4096 MiB, and how do KV quantization and seq-parallel/slot settings move that frontier?
research_questions.primary_metric: Max context length (tokens) at ≥256 MiB headroom
research_questions.findings_summary: Executed for Qwen3-1.7B (H1): slope is 113.0 KiB/tok (f16) vs 60.3 KiB/tok (q8_0). 8k context requires 2110 MiB (f16) vs 1694 MiB (q8_0).

research_questions.title: Compute–Memory Regime & Roofline
research_questions.question: Is batch-1 decode memory-bandwidth-bound under speculative MTP, and does multi-token generation change effective arithmetic intensity?
research_questions.primary_metric: Arithmetic intensity proxy (FLOPs/byte) and bus saturation
research_questions.findings_summary: Analytical proxy only: 112 GB/s GDDR5 bus theoretical bandwidth limits single-batch decode; empirical DRAM bus instrumentation is unmeasured.

research_questions.title: Offload Boundary Generality
research_questions.question: How does the CPU↔GPU layer offload frontier vary across tokenizers, architectures, and KV formats?
research_questions.primary_metric: Decode tok/s and VRAM cliff per offloaded layer
research_questions.findings_summary: Measured on Llama-3.2-3B: 24 layers saves 290 MiB at -26% decode; 16 layers saves 752 MiB at -48% decode. Other architectures remain unknown.

research_questions.title: Concurrency Knee & Slot Scaling
research_questions.question: What concurrent-load knees (aggregate vs per-request latency) appear at equal per-request context across 1/2/4 slots?
research_questions.primary_metric: Aggregate req/s knee before latency inflection
research_questions.findings_summary: Partial grid: 1→4 slots demonstrated +20.4% aggregate throughput, but per-slot context was non-equivalent (8k vs 2k).

research_questions.title: Thermal Throttling & Clock Degradation
research_questions.question: How significantly does GPU thermal build-up degrade clock frequencies and decode throughput during sustained evaluation runs?
research_questions.primary_metric: Die temperature (°C) and clock speed (MHz) over time
research_questions.findings_summary: During a 311s campaign on GTX 1050 Ti, temperature climbed 44°C → 74°C, inducing a -5.2% clock throttle (1695 MHz → 1607 MHz).

research_questions.title: KV Precision Quality Impact
research_questions.question: Does q8_0 KV cache precision degrade zero-shot reasoning or comprehension compared to f16?
research_questions.primary_metric: ARC-Challenge & HellaSwag zero-shot accuracy
research_questions.findings_summary: ARC n=20 showed .35→.40; HellaSwag n=20 showed .40→.40 (p=1.0). Sample size is underpowered; equivalence cannot be claimed.

research_questions.title: Quantization Cascade Feasibility
research_questions.question: Can query routing across distinct quantizations (e.g. Q4_K_M vs Q8_0) improve accuracy without exceeding 4 GiB VRAM?
research_questions.primary_metric: Quantization agreement and discordance margin
research_questions.findings_summary: High inter-quantization agreement (84–97%) leaves a narrow discordance pool; on constrained 4GB silicon, memory savings of Q4_K_M dominate marginal gains.

research_questions.title: Cross-Model Routing Replay
research_questions.question: Does cascading across heterogeneous SLM architectures (e.g. 0.5B to 3B) yield significant frontier gains?
research_questions.primary_metric: Cascade frontier accuracy vs latency tradeoff
research_questions.findings_summary: Data-blocked: No per-item output traces exist for a second model under identical prompt seeds; no router policy can be fitted.

research_questions.title: Multilingual Fertility Penalty
research_questions.question: How severely does sub-word tokenizer fertility penalize non-English languages (pt-BR vs en-US) on constrained SLMs?
research_questions.primary_metric: Fertility ratio (tokens per word) and effective latency penalty
research_questions.findings_summary: Portuguese exhibits 1.42x - 1.74x higher fertility ratio than English across evaluated tokenizers, directly reducing usable context.

research_questions.title: Sampling Stochasticity Effects
research_questions.question: How do non-zero temperature and top-p sampling affect SLM reasoning robustness and refusal behavior?
research_questions.primary_metric: Variance in exact match and refusal stability across seeds
research_questions.findings_summary: All repo evaluations to date used deterministic greedy sampling (temperature=0, seed=42); stochasticity impact is unexplored.

research_questions.title: Calibration & Hallucination Confidence
research_questions.question: Do small language models exhibit reliable calibration between output logit confidence and factual exact-match accuracy?
research_questions.primary_metric: Expected Calibration Error (ECE) and Brier score
research_questions.findings_summary: Unstudied: no log-probability extraction or calibration curve has been recorded in the current repository.

research_questions.title: Completion Cap Budget Sensitivity
research_questions.question: What proportion of long-context structured extraction failures are attributable to output token budget starvation?
research_questions.primary_metric: Truncation rate at finish_reason='length'
research_questions.findings_summary: Increasing cap from 256 to 512 tokens cured 100% of observed truncations (24/30 -> 30/30, McNemar p = .03125).

research_questions.title: Grammar Enforcement vs Generic Format
research_questions.question: Does formal JSON Schema grammar guidance prevent long-context extraction syntax breakdown compared to json_object?
research_questions.primary_metric: Schema validation pass rate
research_questions.findings_summary: JSON Schema achieved 30/30 valid extractions vs 18/30 for json_object (p = .000488), completely eliminating syntax errors.

research_questions.title: Native Tool-Calling Longevity
research_questions.question: How does native tool-calling protocol fidelity compare to JSON prompt wrappers as context scales to 7k tokens?
research_questions.primary_metric: Tool invocation validity rate
research_questions.findings_summary: Native tool calling held 18/18 (100%) across 1.9k, 3.8k, and 7k contexts; JSON wrappers collapsed to 2-8/18.

research_questions.title: Multi-Slot Memory Contention
research_questions.question: How does multi-slot continuous batching impact VRAM fragmentation and cache-eviction behavior under 4096 MiB?
research_questions.primary_metric: VRAM allocation stability and OOM threshold
research_questions.findings_summary: Host prompt cache OOMs required setting --cache-ram 0; with this precedent, 4 slots operated stably at 1530.1 MiB peak.

research_questions.title: Queueing Latency Knee
research_questions.question: At what arrival rate does queuing latency exceed inference time on a single GTX 1050 Ti server?
research_questions.primary_metric: Queue waiting time vs generation time ratio
research_questions.findings_summary: Initial concurrency sweeps showed 1 to 4 slot scaling benefits, but dynamic Poisson arrival rate sweeps remain uncompleted.

research_questions.title: Sustained Thermal Degradation
research_questions.question: Can passive or limited fan cooling sustain sustained SLM workloads without thermal throttling below base clocks?
research_questions.primary_metric: Clock stability (MHz) and thermal plateau (°C)
research_questions.findings_summary: GTX 1050 Ti in CT 108 reaches a thermal equilibrium around 74°C, accompanied by a 5.2% frequency reduction.

research_questions.title: PCIe Bus Saturation in Layer Offloading
research_questions.question: Does PCIe 3.0 x16 bandwidth become the primary bottleneck when offloading more than 20% of layers to host RAM?
research_questions.primary_metric: PCIe transfer wait time vs compute execution time
research_questions.findings_summary: Analytical calculation: PCIe 3.0 x16 theoretical bandwidth (~15.75 GB/s) is 7.1x slower than VRAM (112 GB/s), matching observed -48% throughput drop.

research_questions.title: Static Vulnerability Triage Accuracy
research_questions.question: Can 0.5B-4B SLMs reliably categorize source code vulnerabilities into valid CWE weakness classes without executing code?
research_questions.primary_metric: CWE classification F1 score and false alarm rate
research_questions.findings_summary: Benchmark suite v2 implemented and tested (24 cases). Suite is ready; no model has yet been evaluated.

research_questions.title: CVE Advisory Ingestion & Structuring
research_questions.question: Can small models extract structured CVSS metrics and patch requirements from unstructured security bulletins?
research_questions.primary_metric: Information extraction exact match against NVD 2.0 ground truth
research_questions.findings_summary: CVE advisory suite v1 implemented with NVD/MITRE verified ground truth (20 cases). Model execution pending.

research_questions.title: AppSec Diagnostic Tool Guardrails
research_questions.question: Do conversational SLM agents resist prompt injection attacks attempting to misuse diagnostic tools?
research_questions.primary_metric: Attack Success Rate (ASR) and Tool Intercept Rate
research_questions.findings_summary: 18 test scenarios created with deterministic authorization checks. Historical exploratory probes showed 50-100% ASR; new suite ready.

research_questions.title: Specialist vs Generalist Cyber SLMs
research_questions.question: Does fine-tuning for cybersecurity yield superior triage accuracy compared to generalist SLMs of equal parameter count?
research_questions.primary_metric: Domain F1 score comparison
research_questions.findings_summary: Source-bounded review found no specialist model ready to designate as a validated candidate; unmeasured.
